verdict.rationale: The pack shows Asana supports creating and authorizing with an API token and registering MCP apps in the developer console. Nothing documents scoping those credentials to least privilege for an external agent. The 'scoped permissions' claim covers Asana's own built-in AI Teammates governed from its console, which is a related feature rather than issuable scoped API credentials, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
